llm.reply:
The primary records retrieved for this query relate to the genetics of the condition, including the gene fibrillin 1 [6]. Other relevant genetic records include the gene transforming growth factor beta receptor 2 [2]. Another associated record is the gene transforming growth factor beta receptor 1 [4].

## Sequence Variants
Multiple specific sequence variants are noted in the primary records. One identified variant is NM_003242.6(TGFBR2):c.944C>T (p.Thr315Met) [1]. Another identified variant is NM_004612.4(TGFBR1):c.722C>T (p.Ser241Leu) [3].

## Clinical Features
The contextual records outline the phenotype for Marfan syndrome [20]. MedGen lists these clinical features: Aortic regurgitation [21], Arachnodactyly [22], Astigmatism [23], Ectopia lentis [24], Esotropia [25], Exotropia [26], Pes planus [27], Glaucoma [28], Congestive heart failure [29] and Hypertropia [30].
